title: 第3章 许景明和黎渺渺（上）

第3章许景明和黎渺渺（上）
“我得罪谁了？”许景明问道。
方星龙看着许景明，说出了一个名字：“程子豪。”
许景明心中完全明白了，平静问道：“师兄，他找你了？”
“嗯。”方星龙点头。
许景明点头道：“我是和他有矛盾。”
“你一个职业武道选手，高中就入选省队，后来进国家队，这么多年一直在职业武道圈。你怎么会和程子豪有矛盾？”方星龙无法理解，双方根本不是一个圈子。
许景明笑着道：“生活嘛，就是充满无限可能。”
“别嬉皮笑脸了。”方星龙有些焦急担心，“你和他的矛盾，没法化解吗？”
“化解不了。”许景明摇头。
方星龙掐掉手中的烟，看着自己的师弟：“景明，那是程子豪！你得罪了他，在网络上就等于被封杀了！”
“我知道，程家嘛！”许景明感慨道，“程家掌控着虎鲨集团，一家市值超过五万亿的公司，互联网排名前三的巨无霸集团，的确很可怕。”
程氏家族，夏国富豪榜排名前十，家族财富超过五千亿。夏国如今的第一直播平台‘虎鲨’就是程家传奇人物‘程云秀’在六十多年前创立，六十多年，虎鲨集团未曾没落，反而越加壮大。如今形成以虎鲨平台为核心，辐射电商、音乐、游戏等多行业的互联网巨无霸集团，虎鲨集团市值超五万亿，程家作为创始家族，也有8.2%的股份，并且投票权一直超过50%，牢牢把握着虎鲨集团掌控权。
虎鲨集团足有三十年时间，完全由创始人程云秀掌控，他死后，由他的独子程立韦掌管至今。
程子豪，便是程立韦的儿子，今年三十二岁。
“在网络上，虎鲨集团是排在前三的巨无霸集团。直播平台它更是排第一，你一个武道选手，你根本不清楚，它的影响力到底多么恐怖。”方星龙看着自己的师弟，有些心急。
“我当然清楚。”许景明微笑道，“被封杀了，从此没有任何商业活动，网络上也没宣传，名气也会迅速消失。”
武道选手，名气很重要。
名气越大，收入越高。
论武道大赛成绩，许景明虽然挺强，但在夏国历史上顶尖武道选手中也只能算三线！师父柳海这种有传奇性的才算是一线，毕竟四十多岁高龄连续五届大赛都是前三，且还拿过世界第一。

一线选手有三位，个个是传奇，他们的一场巅峰对决出场费都是过亿的，职业生涯累计收入更是恐怖。
历史顶尖选手，二线水准的，是那些拿过世界前三的，或者艰难拿过一次世界第一就退役的。他们也会经常被人们提起，巅峰对决的出场费一般都是过千万的。
许景明，两次杀进世界武道大赛，一次十六强，一次八强。最高一次出场费也仅仅是一百五十万，单笔最高收入还是世界武道大赛的八强奖金。奋斗这么多年所有收入累计也就几千万，从收入就能看出实力地位。
论成绩，夏国历史选手三线。论名气？网络上被封杀，名气会迅速消失。
“武道选手也要吃饭的，有时候退一步，海阔天空。”方星龙劝说道。
“师兄。”许景明认真道，“你知道的，有些事，是没法退的。”
方星龙一怔，微微点头，担忧道：“仅仅封杀你还是小事，就怕程子豪接着找你麻烦。”
许景明笑道：“大不了，我回老家明月市，在明月市，我八极门、戳脚门有上千名弟子，我看他怎么找我麻烦。而且现代社会，监控处处，他能怎样？”
“那你回明月市准备干什么？”方星龙追问。
“开个武馆，做些高端私教，也能吃饱。”许景明说道，“我好歹也是枪魔，靠技术吃饭的，在哪都能吃饱。”
方星龙微微摇头：“明月市那样的二线城市，你辛辛苦苦一年能赚一百万就不错了。”
“我这么多年赚的，吃利息分红也不少。”许景明说道，“师兄，不用担心我。”
许景明和程子豪撕破脸，就做好了准备。
少赚些罢了。
他从小受父亲影响，成为明月市两大传统武术门派‘八极门’‘戳脚门’的弟子。自从世界武道大赛成为世界第一大格斗赛事，国内传统武术流派便再次绽放光芒，各种兵器格斗技巧被挖掘出来。
现代社会，并不在意弟子拜多少个门派。
许景明的父亲，年轻时是武术博主，行走全球各地，探访全球各个格斗流派。他国内就加入过十余个武术门派，更得八极一脉真传，定居明月市后，还在明月市创建了八极门。现代社会，全国各地的武术流派都很多，传承有序的八极门，在全国都有数百家。
许景明，是明月市八极门继承人，也是明月市戳脚门门主弟子！开武馆收徒，搞高端私教，都能吃饱饭。
“或许，回家乡潜心练枪法更加适合我。若是能达到更高境界，便可复出冲击世界第一。”许景明想着。
他从来没放弃过世界第一的梦想，师父柳海，四十多岁高龄都连续五届杀进世界武道大赛，硬是最终夺得世界第一。

自己今年才二十九，怎么可能放弃？
若是拿到世界第一，冠军奖金便是五亿，更将全球瞩目。官方媒体都会铺天盖地宣传，哪是一个程子豪压得住的。
至于现在？自己一个退役职业选手，没足够高成就，被封杀也没办法。
“师兄，程子豪找你说什么了？”许景明看着方星龙。
“程子豪让人和我传了话，让我辞掉你。”方星龙惭愧道，“景明，你知道，我是卖酒的，销售的部分渠道便是虎鲨集团的直播平台、电商平台，而且很多宣传也要透过虎鲨集团，我虽然很憋屈，但我惹不起程子豪，毕竟公司不是我一个人的。”
“师兄，我知道你的苦处。”许景明点头。
自己是靠技术吃饭的，凭借近三十年全球前十的枪法，自己不怕没饭吃。只是吃的多点少点罢了。
但师兄方星龙是商人，酒业公司是师兄的事业根基，在虎鲨集团面前反而更束手束脚。
“这次省队集训结束，我就离开。”许景明说道。
方星龙有些疲惫：“能告诉师兄，你和程子豪到底有什么矛盾？”
“我不想说。”许景明摇头，“只能说，他是一个疯子！”
“疯子？”
方星龙若有所思，微微点头，“好，我也不多说了，这次是师兄对不住你。”
“不关师兄的事，反而是我连累了师兄。”许景明很清楚方星龙为人，豪爽、真诚，人品毋庸置疑。否则自己也不会接受他的邀请，来当这座格斗馆的馆主。
“师兄，我还得去陪刘领队吃饭，就先走了，有事我们电话聊。”许景明笑着说了句，便离开了。
方星龙站在原地，目送许景明离去。
“程子豪。”
方星龙轻声低语，他闯荡商界四十岁出头便有数十亿身家，骨子里也是很骄傲的。他酷爱武道兵器格斗，为了爱好，便一掷千金建造星空格斗馆。这次却被程子豪一声传话，就得乖乖辞退师弟，他怎能不憋气？
“惹不起啊。”方星龙默默低语，再憋气，该低头时就低头，商界闯荡多年他很清楚这点，只是混到他如今的身份，这么憋屈的事已经很少了。
“程子豪，不讲规矩，玩阴的，终有一天要栽跟头。”方星龙暗道。

方星龙也在思考着，怎么才能帮到师弟。
他认同的好友不超过十个，许景明便是其中之一，他自然不愿看到师弟吃这么大亏。
夜色朦胧，滨海市东郊的一座联排别墅，许景明推门而入。
卧室，一名穿着睡衣的身材窈窕女子半躺着，倚靠着靠背，戴着一副比较大的眼镜，双手各拿着一手柄。
“景明，等我打完这局游戏啊。”睡衣女子双眸有神，眼镜是虚拟眼镜，分为沉浸模式和现实模式。
现实模式，是将游戏场景部分透明化，便可观看到外界。
“渺渺，你得多运动运动，总这么躺着，对身体不好。”许景明说道。
“好啦，知道啦。”睡衣女子随口应着，双手不停动着。
许景明颇为无奈。
这位睡衣女子，就是他的女友黎渺渺。

Chapter 3 Xu Jingming and Li Miaomiao (Part 1)
"Who did I offend?" Xu Jingming asked.
Fang Xinglong looked at Xu Jingming and said a name: "Cheng Zihao."
Xu Jingming understood completely in his heart and asked calmly: "Brother, is he looking for you?"
"Yeah." Fang Xinglong nodded.
Xu Jingming nodded and said, "I have a conflict with him."
"You are a professional martial arts player. You were selected for the provincial team in high school and later entered the national team. You have been in the professional martial arts circle for so many years. How come you have conflicts with Cheng Zihao?" Fang Xinglong couldn't understand that the two parties were not in the same circle at all.
Xu Jingming smiled and said: "Life is full of infinite possibilities."
"Stop smiling so playfully." Fang Xinglong was a little anxious and worried, "Can't the conflict between you and him be resolved?"
"It can't be resolved." Xu Jingming shook his head.
Fang Xinglong pinched off the cigarette in his hand and looked at his junior brother: "Jing Ming, that's Cheng Zihao! If you offend him, you will be banned from the Internet!"
"I know, the Cheng family!" Xu Jingming said with emotion, "The Cheng family controls the Tiger Shark Group, a company with a market value of more than 5 trillion, and one of the top three giant groups on the Internet. It is indeed terrifying."
The Cheng family ranks among the top ten richest people in the Xia Kingdom, with a family wealth of over 500 billion. Xia Kingdom’s current number one live broadcast platform ‘Husha’ was founded by the legendary ‘Cheng Yunxiu’ of the Cheng family more than sixty years ago. Over the past sixty years, the Husha Group has not declined, but has grown stronger. Nowadays, an Internet giant group has been formed with the Husha platform as its core, radiating into e-commerce, music, games and other industries. The market value of the Husha Group exceeds 5 trillion. As the founding family, the Cheng family also has 8.2% of the shares, and the voting rights have always exceeded 50%, firmly holding the control of the Husha Group.
Tiger Shark Group has been completely controlled by founder Cheng Yunxiu for thirty years. After his death, his only son Cheng Liwei has been in charge until now.
Cheng Zihao is Cheng Liwei's son, he is thirty-two years old this year.
"On the Internet, the Tiger Shark Group is one of the top three giant groups. It is also ranked number one on the live broadcast platform. As a martial arts player, you have no idea how terrifying its influence is." Fang Xinglong looked at his junior brother, a little anxious.
"Of course I know." Xu Jingming smiled and said, "After being banned, there will be no commercial activities from now on, there will be no publicity on the Internet, and the reputation will disappear quickly."
For martial arts players, reputation is very important.
The greater the fame, the higher the income.
In terms of results in martial arts competitions, although Xu Jingming is very strong, he can only be ranked in the third tier among the top martial arts players in the history of Xia Kingdom! Legendary masters like Master Liu Hai are considered to be on the front line. After all, at the age of over 40, he has been in the top three in five consecutive competitions and even won the first place in the world.
There are three first-line players, all of whom are legends. Their appearance fee for a peak match is over 100 million, and their cumulative career income is even more terrifying.
The top players in history, the second-tier players, are those who have won the top three in the world, or those who retired after struggling to win the world's first place once. They are also often mentioned by people, and the appearance fees for peak matches usually exceed tens of millions.
Xu Jingming has reached the World Martial Arts Competition twice, once in the top 16 and once in the top eight. The highest one-time appearance fee is only 1.5 million, and the highest single income is the top eight prize money of the World Martial Arts Competition. After so many years of hard work, the cumulative income is only tens of millions. From the income, you can see your strength and status.
In terms of performance, Xia Guo's historical players are in the third tier. On fame? Being banned from the internet will quickly lead to your fame disappearing.
"Martial arts players also need to eat. Sometimes, if you take a step back, the world will be brighter." Fang Xinglong advised.
"Senior brother," Xu Jingming said seriously, "You know, there are some things that you can't back out of."
Fang Xinglong was startled, nodded slightly, and said worriedly: "Just banning you is a small matter, I'm afraid Cheng Zihao will cause trouble for you next."
Xu Jingming smiled and said, "No big deal, I'll go back to my hometown."Mingyue City, in Mingyue City, there are thousands of disciples of my Baji Sect and Zhajiao Sect. I wonder how they can cause trouble for me. Moreover, in modern society, surveillance is everywhere, what can he do? "
"Then what are you going to do when you return to Mingyue City? "Fang Xinglong asked.
“Open a martial arts gym, do some high-end personal training, and you’ll be able to make a living. "Xu Jingming said, "I am also a gun demon after all. I rely on skills to make a living, and I can make a full meal anywhere. "
Fang Xinglong shook his head slightly: "In a second-tier city like Mingyue City, if you can earn one million a year after your hard work, it's pretty good. "
“I have earned a lot over the years, and I have received a lot of interest and dividends. "Xu Jingming said, "Brother, don't worry about me. "
Xu Jingming and Cheng Zihao broke up and got ready.
Just make less.
Influenced by his father since childhood, he became a disciple of the two major traditional martial arts sects in Mingyue City, the "Baji Sect" and the "Stab the Foot Sect". Since the World Martial Arts Competition became the world's largest fighting event, domestic traditional martial arts schools have once again blossomed, and various weapon fighting techniques have been discovered.
In modern society, it doesn’t matter how many sects a disciple belongs to.
Xu Jingming's father was a martial arts blogger when he was young. He traveled around the world and visited various fighting schools around the world. He has joined more than ten martial arts sects in China, and even obtained the true inheritance of the Baji lineage. After settling in Mingyue City, he also founded the Baji Sect in Mingyue City. In modern society, there are many martial arts schools across the country, and there are hundreds of Baji sects with orderly inheritance across the country.
Xu Jingming is the heir to the Baji Sect in Mingyue City and the disciple of the master of the Mingyue City Sect! Opening a martial arts gym to recruit disciples or engaging in high-end personal training can make a living.
“Perhaps it would be more suitable for me to go back to my hometown and concentrate on practicing marksmanship. If you can reach a higher level, you can come back and hit the number one spot in the world. "Xu Jingming thought.
He has never given up his dream of being number one in the world. His master, Liu Hai, who is over 40 years old, has entered the World Martial Arts Competition for five consecutive years and finally won the number one in the world.
I am only twenty-nine this year, how could I give up?
If you get the first place in the world, the championship bonus will be 500 million, which will attract global attention. The official media will be overwhelmingly publicizing it, but no one Cheng Zihao can suppress it.
As for now? As a retired professional player, I don't have high enough achievements, so I can't do anything about being banned.
"Senior brother, what did Cheng Zihao tell you? "Xu Jingming looked at Fang Xinglong.
"Cheng Zihao had someone tell me and asked me to fire you. Fang Xinglong said with shame, "Jing Ming, you know, I sell wine, and part of my sales channels are the Tiger Shark Group's live broadcast platform and e-commerce platform, and a lot of publicity also goes through the Tiger Shark Group. Although I feel aggrieved, I can't afford to offend Cheng Zihao. After all, the company does not belong to me alone." "
"Brother, I know your suffering. "Xu Jingming nodded.
He relies on his skills to make a living. With his marksmanship among the top ten in the world in the past thirty years, he is not afraid of running out of food. Just eat more and less.
However, senior brother Fang Xinglong is a businessman, and the liquor company is the foundation of his career. However, he is even more helpless in front of the Tiger Shark Group.
“I will leave after this provincial team training session is over. "Xu Jingming said.
Fang Xinglong was a little tired: "Can you tell me, senior brother, what exactly is the conflict between you and Cheng Zihao? "
"I don't want to say it. "Xu Jingming shook his head, "I can only say that he is a madman! "
"Crazy? "
Fang Xinglong was thoughtful and nodded slightly, "Okay, I won't say more, this time it's senior brother who can't forgive you. "
“It’s none of Senior Brother’s business, but it’s me who has caused Senior Brother trouble. "Xu Jingming knew very well that Fang Xinglong was a generous, sincere, and unquestionable character. Otherwise, he would not have accepted his invitation to become the owner of this fighting gym.
"Senior brother, I have to go have dinner with Leader Liu, so I'll leave first. If anything happens, we can chat on the phone. "Xu Jingming said with a smile and left.
Fang Xinglong stood there and watched Xu Jingming leave.
"Cheng Zihao. "
Fang Xinglong whispered softly, he broke into the businessIn his early forties, he has a net worth of billions, and he is very proud at heart. He loves martial arts weapon fighting, and for his hobby, he spent a lot of money to build a starry sky fighting gym. This time, Cheng Zihao told him that he had to dismiss his junior brother obediently. How could he not hold his breath?
"I can't afford to offend you." Fang Xinglong whispered silently, no matter how hard he held his breath, he would bow his head when it was time to bow his head. He knew this very well after many years in the business world, but with his current status, there were very few such aggrieved things.
"Cheng Zihao, if you don't follow the rules and play dirty tricks, you will fall into trouble one day." Fang Xinglong thought to himself.
Fang Xinglong was also thinking about how he could help his junior brother.
He recognized no more than ten friends, and Xu Jingming was one of them. Naturally, he didn't want to see his junior brother suffer such a big loss.
In the hazy night, Xu Jingming pushed open the door of a townhouse in the eastern suburbs of Binhai City.
In the bedroom, a slim woman in pajamas was lying half-lying, leaning on the backrest, wearing a pair of relatively large glasses, holding a handle in each hand.
"Jing Ming, wait until I finish this game." The woman in pajamas has bright eyes. Her glasses are virtual glasses, which are divided into immersion mode and reality mode.
Reality mode makes the game scene partially transparent so that you can see the outside world.
"Miaomiao, you need to exercise more. Lying like this all the time is not good for your health." Xu Jingming said.
"Okay, I know." The woman in pajamas responded casually, her hands moving constantly.
Xu Jingming was quite helpless.
This woman in pajamas is his girlfriend Li Miaomiao.
